verbosity.description: Global log verbosity: 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug

user_friendly_names.description: Enable user-friendly device names (e.g., 'mpath0') instead of WWIDs

find_multipaths.description: If true, only create multipath devices when multiple paths exist; if false, create on first path

hardware_handler.description: Hardware handler module to use (e.g., 'alua', 'emc', 'hp_sw'). Set to '' to disable.

max_fds.description: Maximum number of file descriptors multipathd may use

queue_depth.description: Default queue depth per multipath device

rr_min_io.description: Number of I/Os before switching path in round-robin (0 = default)

rr_min_io_rq.description: Number of I/O requests before switching path (0 = use device default)

devices.description: List of per-device configuration overrides (one per vendor/product pair)

description.description: Optional human-readable description for documentation purposes

alias.description: Custom alias for this device (overrides user-friendly names)

wwid.description: Explicit WWID to match (supports wildcards * and ?)

path_grouping_policy.description: Override path grouping policy for this device (empty = global default)

path_selector.description: Override path selector for this device (empty = global default)

prio.description: Override priority plugin for this device (empty = global default)

checker.description: Override path checker for this device (empty = global default)

pg_init_retries.description: Number of retries to initialize a path group

pg_init_delay.description: Seconds to wait before initializing path group

getuid_callout.description: External program to call for path UID (e.g., '/sbin/scsi_id -g -u -s')

hardware_handler.description: Hardware handler for this device (empty = global default)

path_failover_threshold.description: Number of failed paths before switching to failover mode

fast_io_fail_tmo.description: Seconds before failing I/O during path failure (-1 = use device map)

dev_loss_tmo.description: Seconds before removing a lost path from the device map

write_barriers.description: Enable write barriers for this device (ensures write ordering)

detect_prio.description: Enable automatic detection of path priority states

deferred_remove.description: Defer device removal until all references are released

max_fds.description: Max file descriptors for this device (overrides global)
